title: Opposite the bank
goal: Give and follow directions in town with arasında and karşısında, and the dative postpositions göre, doğru and kadar.

intro.text: Three more place nouns: *ara* (space between), *karşı* (opposite side), *dış* (outside): *bankanın karşısında* (opposite the bank). And three postpositions that want the dative: *bana göre* (in my opinion), *denize doğru* (towards the sea), *köprüye kadar* (as far as the bridge).

vocab.en: according to; in … opinion (after the dative)

exercises.question: How do you say **opposite the bank**?

why.1: As a place noun, *karşı* follows the genitive: *bankanın karşısında*.
why.2: *Karşı* ends in a vowel, so the possessive is *-sı*: *karşısında*.
why.3: The bank goes into the genitive, and *karşı* takes a possessive and a case.

exercises.en: The pharmacy is between the bank and the hotel.

reject.why: *Ara* is a place noun: the reference takes the genitive, *otelin arasında*.

exercises.explain: Between two places: *A ile B'nin arasında*. Only the second takes the genitive: *bankayla otelin arasında*.

exercises.prompt: There is a park opposite the school.

reject.why: After *okulun*, *karşı* needs the possessive and n: *karşısında*.

exercises.en: The stop is next to the bridge.

exercises.prompt: Bana göre İzmir İstanbul'dan daha güzel.
accept: In my opinion, Izmir is more beautiful than Istanbul.
In my opinion, Izmir is [nicer|prettier|lovelier] than Istanbul.
I think Izmir is [more beautiful|nicer|prettier|lovelier] than Istanbul.
For me, Izmir is [more beautiful|nicer|prettier|lovelier] than Istanbul.

exercises.question: What does *Denize doğru yürüdük* mean?
options: We walked straight to the sea.
It's true, we walked to the sea.

why.2: On its own, *doğru* means **true**; after a dative it means **towards**.

exercises.text: Bu yoldan köprü___ kadar düz gidin.
exercises.en: Go straight along this road as far as the bridge.

reject.why: **As far as** is the dative + *kadar*: *köprüye kadar*.
*Köprü* ends in a vowel, so a buffer y comes first: *köprüye*.

exercises.explain: Dative + *kadar*: **until, as far as**. A buffer y after the vowel: *köprüye*.

reject.why: You turn **to** the right: the dative, *sağa*.

exercises.text: The hotel is opposite the museum.

exercises.en: The pharmacy is between two banks.

context.en: Excuse me, where is the museum?

context.tr: Bu caddeden düz gidin. Kavşağa kadar yürüyün, sonra sola dönün.
context.en: Go straight along this avenue. Walk as far as the intersection, then turn left.

context.tr: Evet. Müze sağda, parkın karşısında. Durak da müzenin önünde.
context.en: Yes. The museum is on the right, opposite the park. And the stop is in front of the museum.

accept: They live in a house outside the city.
They live in a house outside [of the city|town|of town|the town|of the town].
They are living in a house outside (of) [the city|town|the town].

exercises.prompt: In my opinion, this hotel is very expensive.
accept: Bana göre bu otel çok pahalı.
Bu otel bana göre çok pahalı.

reject.answer: Benim göre bu otel çok pahalı.
